mission.title: Remote Control
mission.description: Trace the helicopter that carried off the Exile program Sati, and take control of it.

npc.say: Ah, Sati is very valuable to the System, tesoro! Her spectacular sunrises and sunsets are pleasing to the humans, and help maintain satisfaction levels!
Mayday, mayday! We have hostile contact!

phase.briefing:
{player}, the Oracle's ward, the Exile program known as "Sati," has been abducted by the General's commandos by means of a helicopter.
The helicopter disappeared from our scanners with Sati aboard. It has since reappeared over the city, without Sati. Sati's signal is no longer detected within the Matrix.
We are sending you to the ground position closest to the point of the helicopter's flight where Sati was last confirmed on board. You will conduct a detailed scan of the area.

enter.say:
All right, they're pumping scan sweeps through your RSI. Just move around the area until I let you know you've covered enough ground for them to have a full scan.
And stop scratching yourself. It makes the scan come out funny.

done.say: Right, they say they've got enough data. The sensor relay has been switched off, so you're no longer a walking radar dish. Any residual tingling sensations you feel are purely a bonus.

phase.briefing: The scan data obtained contains traces of an unknown transmission. A relay point has been identified. Proceed there and search the area.

enter.say: Looks like you ain't done playing lightning rod yet. Just keep moving around in there. I'll let you know when they've got the data they need.

done.say: Looks like they got something, {player}. You can get out of there.

phase.briefing: A subsequent relay point has been found, {player}. Commando programs have been detected. You will receive additional support from Agent Pace.

enter.say:
I'm scanning Agent Pace...
Looking good so far.

objective.text: Get the Virus from Agent Pace

talk.say: Saluti, {player}! Please take this virus from me. You will need it for your next task.

Okay, you're going to get a virus from Agent Pace.
Did that... Oh, never mind.

done.say: I have the virus you will need. Additionally, these two programs here have been assigned to assist you. Buona fortuna--good luck--in this mission!

You're cleared to lead those two out of there.
One of these days Agent Pace is gonna let us take her somewhere. I know just the place...

objective.text: Lead Royce Warnock and Louis Ocampo out of the area

phase.briefing: Proceed to the target location and eliminate all opposition.

enter.say:
It's a bad day to be a commando.
I've got multiple contacts in there, {player}. Go give 'em the business.

done.say: You will find a computer system nearby, {player}. Insert the virus into the system.

objective.text: Put the Virus in the Computer

done.say: Okay, now check the computer to execute the virus, and see what happens.
Huh, wonder what that did. Looks like it worked, whatever it was.

mission.finish:
I see you have questions, operative. The signal you detected earlier indicated that the helicopter was being controlled remotely. The virus you activated in their control system re-routed the helicopter to one of our helipads. The vehicle has now been thoroughly inspected. No trace of Sati, or indication of how she vanished from our scanners, has been found.
The data available to us at this point indicates a high probability that Sati has been removed from the main simulation. As she controls certain routines beneficial to the maintenance of the System, this removal could have detrimental consequences if not soon corrected.
You will be contacted when we have another task for you. Good day.
